title: Refined direction for MAXAUT
question: This reroll follows your cleaner off-white and black steer. Choose the software-led recommendation, its more artful alternate, or steer it once more.

options.label: The Quiet System
options.lineage: Precision industrial design, architectural section drawings, and calm product launches
options.body: A matte off-white field, near-black typography, generous negative space, and one cobalt operational signal. The first viewport makes one decisive promise and shows a single system line moving from ERP core to controlled agent actions. As the visitor scrolls, that line becomes a process map, an implementation sequence, and finally the discovery-call action. The system is minimal but not empty: precise labels, real workflow language, and subtle motion provide the technical authority. Honest risk: restraint raises the standard for copy, spacing, and diagram craft, because there is nowhere for weak details to hide.

options.label: Operational Ma
options.lineage: Ikebana composition and active negative space
options.body: ERP, human judgment, and AI agents are arranged as three deliberately balanced operational lines. Pale plaster, weathered charcoal, and a controlled iris-blue accent create a strikingly calm page. It expresses thoughtful intervention beautifully, though the metaphor needs more explanation before it reads as enterprise technology.
